name: hexy-ground-anatomy-clean
prompt: Edit target: supplied 12-cel Hexy animation sheet. Change ONLY layout/padding: REDUCE EACH OF THE TWELVE INDIVIDUAL DRAWINGS TO 74% of its present size about its own cel center. Redraw missing clipped hat tips, hair tips and boot tips to complete each figure. Preserve the EXACT TWO-ARM CHEST GRIP, face, youthful appearance, poses, outfit, rendering and four-cel acting of each row. Output the SAME 4 columns by 3 rows sheet, but with very large 12% empty transparent margins on ALL FOUR SIDES OF EVERY CELL. No pixel of a character may touch an image edge or a neighbouring cell. Every full-body drawing must be complete, including all hat, wand star, hair and both boots. Genuine transparent background, no grid, no labels, no background, no new limbs.
